mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v_product_inventory_query v WHERE

SELECT v.product_id, v.barcode, v.product_name, v.unit, v.category_id, v.category_code, v.category_name, v.warehouse_id, v.warehouse_code, v.warehouse_name, v.tax_cost_price, v.sale_price, v.current_quantity, v.inventory_status, v.data_status FROM v_product_inventory_query v WHERE ORDER BY v.product_id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT v.product_id, v.barcode, v.product_name, v.unit, v.category_id, v.category_code, v.category_name, v.warehouse_id, v.warehouse_code, v.warehouse_name, v.tax_cost_price, v.sale_price, p.remarks, v.current_quantity, v.inventory_status, v.data_status FROM v_product_inventory_query v INNER JOIN product p ON p.id = v.product_id WHERE v.store_id = #{storeId} AND v.product_id = #{productId}
